translations.translatedText: # Sunday 29.1.2017 (radio)

President Donald Trump ordered that citizens of some Muslim countries may not travel to the USA. Ministers of the Finnish government have criticised Trump's order. Norma John will represent Finland in the Eurovision Song Contest. The winter will be fairly warm in the coming days.
## Trump's order
![People carried signs at a demonstration at John F. Kennedy airport in New York on 28 January 2017.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9430154)
Open image viewer
People demonstrated against Trump's order at an airport in New York. Photo: Justin Lane / EPA

People in different parts of the world are puzzled by President Donald Trump's order. On Saturday Trump ordered that citizens of some Muslim countries may not travel to the USA. The countries are Syria, Iran, Iraq, Libya, Somalia, Sudan and Yemen.

The President's order is difficult, for example, in air traffic. At US airports, for example, people have been detained who are not allowed to enter the country because of the President's order. However, a senior judge decided that the authorities may not force them onto a return flight out of the USA.

President Trump's order also has an effect in Finland, because Finnair has flights to the USA. Finnair will not take on these flights citizens of the Muslim countries whom Trump has banned from entering the USA. However, they can get on the flight if they also have, for example, Finnish citizenship.
## Finnish ministers criticise
![Kai Mykkänen and Timo Soini](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9430380)
Open image viewer
Ministers Kai Mykkänen and Timo Soini. Photo: AOP
Ministers of the Finnish government have criticised Trump's order.
Foreign Minister Timo Soini thinks it is unfair if a person cannot get into the USA because of their citizenship.
Minister Kai Mykkänen reminds that Finland and the European Union do not accept discrimination against refugees on the basis of religion. That cannot be accepted in any situation, Mykkänen says.
## Norma John goes to Eurovision
![Norma John](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9306662)
Open image viewer
Lasse Piirainen and Leena Tirronen are the members of Norma John. Photo: Jyrki Valkama/YLE Kuvapalvelu
Finland's entry for the Eurovision Song Contest has been chosen. Finland's entry is a band called Norma John. On Saturday it won the competition in which Finland's entry was chosen.
At Eurovision, Norma John will perform the song Blackbird. The style of the song is dramatic and gothic.
The members of Norma John, Leena Tirronen and Lasse Piirainen, are happy about the win. In May they will travel to Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine, where the Eurovision Song Contest is held this year.
## No freezing weather is coming
![An icy road in a car's headlights](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9375728)
Open image viewer
Roads are slippery when the temperature is around zero degrees. Photo: Riina Kasurinen/Yle
The winter is now fairly warm. There will be no proper frost anywhere in the coming days.

In Southern Finland, in the coming days it will be about 3 degrees warmer than usual for this time of year. In Central Finland the difference is 5 degrees, and in Lapland it is about 6 degrees warmer than usual for this time of year.
Yle meteorologist Seija Paasonen warns that roads can be slippery because the temperature moves on both sides of zero. At times the snow melts, and then it freezes again on the road surface.
